_comment: Grandpa's regional Water homecoming. The selected row matches the live party count; each creature name has its own short line so a five-creature party remains readable.

regional_homecoming_0.speaker: Grandpa Elias
lines: You're home. Word reached us that the Tidewake crossings are free again.
The road from these fields to the outer islands belongs to its people again.
Some companions walk beside us for a season. What they gave us still matters.
Come sit a minute. I'm glad you're here.
